item.title: Transport for London awards oil giant TotalEnergies a contract to deploy 43 DC fast EV chargers
item.description: Transport for London (TfL) has awarded oil supermajor TotalEnergies a contract to deliver up to 43 DC fast EV chargers across London. item.title: Nayax to supply credit card readers to EV charger OEM Tritium
item.description: Israel-based payments platform provider Nayax will supply credit card readers to EV charger manufacturer Tritium. item.description: Finland-based Proventia and Morrow Batteries have signed an agreement for long-term delivery of lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery cells for Proventia’s battery modules and packs used in off-highway machinery and industrial applications. item.title: ROHM adds compact HPLF5060 package to 40 V, 60 V automotive MOSFET lineup
item.description: ROHM has expanded its lineup of low-voltage (40 V, 60 V) automotive MOSFETs by introducing new devices in a compact HPLF5060 package (4.9 mm × 6.0 mm). item.description: Evolito says it is collaborating with Airbus, backed by the UK’s Aerospace Technology Institute and Innovate UK, to develop an on-aircraft electric wheel taxi system that lets aircraft taxi with the main engines switched off.
